items.title: Coatue Builds $1.8 Billion Salesforce Stake, Its Biggest New Bet, as the Stock Sinks 17%
items.summary: Coatue's 13F shows a new 8,032,477-share Salesforce stake worth $1.84 billion on September 30, the largest new position in its $54.50 billion portfolio. The stock has fallen 17% since, including a 9.5% drop on November 17, its worst day since May 2024, as software stocks sold off before Anthropic's IPO.

items.title: Microsoft Stock (MSFT) Forecast – Mizuho Stays Bullish on Strong Revenue Growth Prospects
items.summary: Tech giant Microsoft (MSFT) unveiled new AI models at its Ignite conference amid intense competition from AI players OpenAI and Anthropic (ANT). Reacting to the updates at the conference, Mizuho analyst Gregg Moskowitz reiterated a Buy rating on MSFT stock with a price target of $625.
